messages:
nora_csm: Heads-up — QBR prep for MosaicHealth next Tue. Their 30d spend spiked ~3x due to batch embeddings + retries. Need a quick triage & playbook for the QBR.
elaine_cs: Can you drop the raw numbers and top endpoints?
nora_csm: Quick summary: 30d spend: $36,000 (baseline $12,000). Embeddings ~72% of cost. Top model: openembed-v2, long seqs (~16k), heavy synchronous batching. Multiple clients retried requests.
sam_eng: Suggest immediate mitigations: quota throttle per-client, prefix/KV caching for embeddings reuse, and reduce batch size to avoid OOMs causing retries.
matt_fin: If they stay at this run rate renewal is at risk. We should model a reserved capacity option and a cost vs commit slide.
devon_se: For the QBR slides I recommend 3 clear asks: 1) budget alert at $20k/mo, 2) enablement session to change pipeline to streaming/async + retry backoff, 3) 30-day Dedicated POC.
ops-bot: :warning: incident-bot: We saw 14% retry errors on embeddings endpoint in the last 72h — alerting rule fired.
nora_csm: I'll own the enablement session and customer communication. @sam_eng can you prep model alternatives + quantization numbers?
sam_eng: Yep — will run quick experiments. Initial idea: openembed-quant (8-bit) or ada-emb-1 as a cheaper fallback. Expect ~35-50% embeddings cost reduction depending on latency SLOs. Will share perf table by EOD.
matt_fin: I'll draft renewal recommendation. Quick calc: if they pick a $30k/mo reserved commit, their effective per-token cost drops ~38% vs pay-as-you-go at current peak.
elaine_cs: Capture customer feedback: they call the spikes "unpredictable" and cite UX regressions when retries happen. Add runbook item: set retry cap=3 and exponential backoff starting at 2s, max 10s.
devon_se: I'll create the budget alert proposal and the ticket with ops runbook steps.
ops-bot: (system) budget alert draft created: account=mosaichealth threshold=$20,000 period=monthly. Pending owner confirmation.
nora_csm: Action owners: enablement=nora_csm, model options=sam_eng, finance renewal rec=matt_fin, alerting/devon triage=devon_se. Meeting Mon 10:00 to finalize deck. @qbr_bot please create the invite for the stakeholders.
qbr_bot: (bot) Created calendar event "MosaicHealth QBR cost triage" — Mon 10:00. Invite sent to: nora_csm, elaine_cs, sam_eng, matt_fin, devon_se.
elaine_cs: For slides I'll pull token distribution and top-5 endpoints from analytics; will annotate peak windows.
sam_eng: Quick CLI to create the alert we discussed:
```bash
redwood alerts create --account mosaichealth --type budget --threshold 20000 --period monthly --notify #mosaic-alerts
```
devon_se: For QBR risk label use: "medium-high" (renewal risk if no commit or changes). Provide 3 options: optimize pipeline, purchase reserved, or limit endpoints.
nora_csm: Thanks all — I'll circulate a draft deck by Sunday EOD and we will sync Monday.
